messages:
maria: Quick check — CI flagged a broken link in /docs/deploy/kv-cache.md during the nightly smoke. Can whoever owns the 'deploy' area take a look? I can patch but want owner to confirm canonical target. Repro: click the "model-routing" link -> 404. @jake @liz any idea who's on rotation? :eyes:

jake: I own deploy this week, I can take a look now. Can you paste the exact link or the anchor?

docs-bot: Linkchecker run (nightly): 1 broken link found
  - /docs/deploy/kv-cache.md: link -> /docs/runtime/model-routing (HTTP 404)

maria: full href from CI is: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/model-routing (that's what's 404ing). Looks like the page got moved in the refactor.

sam: quick local search to find references: ```bash
git grep -n "model-routing" docs || true
```

liz: FYI owner rotation: week of Mar 9 -> jake, Mar 16 -> liz (I can pick up if needed). I added a note in docs/OWNERS for deploy.

jake: Found it — the canonical page is now /docs/serving/routing-overview.md. Looks like the link in kv-cache still points to the old path. I can prepare a 1-line fix in the docs repo.

maria: I'll open a tiny PR to redirect the old path and also patch the link in kv-cache so we don't rely on redirects. @jake can you review when it's up? :pray:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421 (small redirect + link fix)

jake: On it. Will do a quick CR. Also adding a test note to the PR: please include the failing URL in the PR description so CI can re-run linkcheck.

marco: Might be worth adding a docs smoke-test step in the deploy pipeline that runs linkcheck for changed files only. Low effort and prevents these slips.

sam: I can add a docs-linkcheck job to docs/.github/workflows/ci.yml. Plan: run htmlproofer (or linkchecker) on changed files, fail pipeline on 4xx. I'll open INFRA PR after this goes green.

maria: filed infra ticket to track: INFRA-402 (add docs link smoke test to docs CI).

jake: Reviewed PR 421, left one comment about redirect target (prefer permanent redirect). Minor. Approved once that's addressed.

maria: thanks! I'll update the PR with permanent redirect, then merge after a CI pass.

liz: Small process suggestion: add a short note in the release checklist to check for moved/renamed doc paths (or ensure redirects exist) so engineers who refactor remember to add redirects.

marco: +1 to checklist. Also adding a quick entry in the docs-ops runbook for owner handoff when moving pages.

maria: Awesome — summary / action items: 1) jake to CR and merge PR 421, 2) sam to add linkcheck job (INFRA-402), 3) liz to update release checklist / OWNERS note. Ping here when complete and I'll close the thread. :rocket:
